title: It’s Not Real Psych
description: The reality is only an illusion
body:
Every shadow hides something alive. Every sound watches you, whispering secrets you don’t want to hear. In It’s Not Real, reality is only a trick. Deformed creatures crawl through the darkness, strange anomalies twist the world around you, and unsettling messages show up when you least expect them, slowly eating away at your sanity. Your mind is weak, your senses are unreliable, and everything you think you know can turn against you at any moment.

There’s a purpose behind this nightmare. The creator of this twisted world is trapped somewhere within it, lost in the maze of their own fears. It’s up to you to find them, navigate the impossible, and survive long enough to bring them back from the edge of madness. Every corner hides a threat, every shadow may reveal something important, and every heartbeat matters.

Survive if you can, uncover the truth if you dare, but remember: nothing is real, and reality itself may be your enemy.
